description: This file defines API routes related to comments in a blogging platform, including creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting comments, with database interactions and authorization checks.

classes.name: Comment
classes.description: Response model for comment data (imported from src.models.models).

methods.name: create_comment( post_id: int, comment: CommentCreate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Handles creation of a new comment on a specified blog post.

methods.name: get_post_comments( post_id: int, skip: int = 0, limit: int = 50, db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of comments for a given blog post, with pagination.

methods.name: update_comment( comment_id: int, comment_update: CommentCreate, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Updates the content of an existing comment if authorized.

methods.name: delete_comment( comment_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Deletes a comment if authorized, updating the comment count on the post.
